clips.title: The story
paras: Jonathan Carevin is a resolute human hunter residing in Darkshire, dedicated to eradicating the darkness plaguing Duskwood. Unlike the defensive Night Watch, he and his family actively hunt down the undead, worgen, and any heretical threats lurking under the darkened canopies.

While Darkshire depends upon the Night Watch to patrol the roads and safeguard the township, Jonathan Carevin believes a mere defensive perimeter is insufficient. Alongside his family and allies like Calor, Jonathan takes the offensive. He actively targets the unholy fiends wandering Duskwood, pursuing a personal crusade to purge all demons, undead, and heretics from the region under the grace of the Light.
